parsed_json.up: Select distinct IC50 activities in nM against target CHEMBL284 (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4). Join activities to assays via assay_id, target_dictionary via tid, docs via doc_id, molecule_dictionary via molregno, and compound_structures via molregno. Left join compound_records on activities.record_id to obtain compound_key. Filter by target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism = 'Homo sapiens', non-null canonical_smiles, and at least one of pubmed_id or doi. For pubmed_id_or_doi, prefer pubmed_id when both are present; otherwise use doi. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Ensure the final projection is DISTINCT across exactly these columns to avoid duplicate rows from many-to-many joins.
